title: Splitting a bounded finite-free complex with projective cohomology
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $L^\bullet$ be a bounded cochain complex of finite free $R$-modules, with cohomology $H^i(L)=\ker(d^i)/\operatorname{im}(d^{i-1})$, viewed in the derived category $D(R)$ of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If every $H^i(L)$ is a projective $R$-module, then in $D(R)$ there is an isomorphism

$$L\simeq\bigoplus_{i\in\mathbf Z}H^i(L)[-i],$$

where only finitely many summands are nonzero. More precisely, writing $B^{i}=\operatorname{im}(d^{i-1})$, the complex $L^\bullet$ is isomorphic, as a complex, to the direct sum of the complexes $H^i(L)[-i]$ (zero differential) and of the two-term complexes $B^{i+1}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}B^{i+1}$ placed in degrees $i,i+1$, and the latter are contractible.
